sentences.text: Every day, people across Nigeria look for a place to live, a place to stay, or a place to meet.
And too often… that means fake listings, hidden fees, and money sent to strangers.
We built Vallo to change that.
Today, Vallo is one home for real estate in Nigeria.
Homes to rent and buy, hotels, shortlets and restaurants… one app, one account.
For owners and landlords, it starts with one simple choice.
List it yourself… with no agency fee.
Add your photos, set your price, and once your ownership is checked, your listing carries the Ownership seen badge.
Hosts get a full desk.
A setup wizard for your rooms… a calendar for every night… bookings, reservations and earnings, all in one place, with cancellation rules you choose.
Restaurants take table deposits, so every reservation counts.
Agents and firms get their own tools.
A portfolio that shows your work, analytics that show what's working, and a firm desk for the whole team… with Vallo Pro and Vallo Business, and a free trial to start.
And if someone books a viewing and doesn't show up… you can report it, and they get forty-eight hours to respond.
Fair for everyone.
Your Vallo passport carries your verified details, so applying for your next place is faster… and you choose who sees it.
Your tenancy file keeps your agreement and your records together.
Once your agreement is approved, pay your rent right in the app… and Vallo reminds you before it's due.
Your Vallo wallet lets you add money, pay, send and withdraw.
And with Protected payment, your money waits in escrow until the deal is done.
Here's the promise.
All funds, in your wallet, in escrow and in every payment, are held by our licensed provider.
Vallo never holds your money.
Trust is built into every step.
Verification checked by a real person.
Account numbers flagged in chat.
And the full cost shown before anyone pays.
Vallo is also a community.
Local talk lets you ask your neighbourhood anything.
Share stories, follow the agents and hosts you trust, and see what's new around you.
And now… Vallo referral rewards are live.
Here's how it works.
Share your invite link.
When a friend joins and gets verified, you earn seventy naira.
After seven days, it's ready.
And once you reach one thousand naira… withdraw it straight to your bank.
The more friends you bring, the more you earn.
This is just the beginning.
We're building the infrastructure for how Nigeria finds, understands, pays for and runs its spaces.
Every home, every room, every table… with real people, real prices and real trust behind it.
Across Nigeria… city by city… Vallo is growing.
Vallo.
Real estate, done right.
Live now on the App Store and Google Play.
Download Vallo today.
